question: What attainment becomes dear to the yoginīs through this practice?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are joined with great accomplishment
This great accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
Such accomplishment may become dear to them
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: The great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
